period_note: SOUTH BANGLA AGRICULTURE AND COMMERCE BANK LIMITED (pre-2023 name). SOLO/STANDALONE basis, unaudited. Balance sheet is the 31-March-2019 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against 31-December-2018 (audited). Income-statement items are for Q1 itself. BONUS SHARE ISSUE FOUND (already reflected in the Dec-2018 comparative column, so it occurred within FY2018 Q4): paid-up capital is 5,658,227,420 at both 31-Dec-2018 and 31-Mar-2019, up from 4,985,222,400 at 30-Sep-2018 (this bank's own 2018_Q3.json) -- exactly a 13.5% bonus issue (4,985,222,400 x 1.135 = 5,658,227,424, matching this bank's own documented dividend history, '13.50% in 2017-for-2018-issue'). Total assets (71,338,940,887), total liabilities (63,770,450,273) and total equity (7,568,490,614, confirmed both by total_assets-minus-total_liabilities and by summing the five reported equity components, which agree exactly) all reconcile. DATA-QUALITY FINDING (this filing's OWN comparative column, not this quarter's primary figures): the Q1-2018 comparative P&L column printed in THIS filing shows 'Provision for taxation' of Tk.145,755,305 -- identical to that same column's own 'Total provision' figure directly above it (an apparent transcription duplication) -- producing a printed comparative PAT of Tk.133,953,112, which diverges from Q1-2018's own contemporaneous, internally-consistent PAT of Tk.130,796,114.25 (2018_Q1.json, sourced independently in this same pass; both agree exactly on pre-tax profit of 279,708,417). This dataset's 2018_Q1.json record keeps the contemporaneous figure; this divergence is flagged here as the cross-report instance where it was first noticed. Printed 'Earning per share (Annualized)' of 0.9611 is PAT (135,955,982)/shares (565,822,742) x4 = 0.9611 exactly; eps_cumulative below is back-derived (0.9611/4=0.24). No classified-loans/NPL, provision, capital-adequacy or NAV-per-share disclosure in this filing -- recorded as a gap.
